title: Add Bottle.static() to serve a directory
description: Adds `app.static(prefix, root, index='index.html', cache_max_age=None, follow_symlinks=False, **options)`, so a directory can be served under a URL prefix without writing the route by hand. Files go out through `static_file()`, so 404, HEAD, Range and conditional requests work as before, and the extra keyword arguments (`mimetype`, `download`, `charset`, `headers`) are passed on to it on every request. Hidden files and directories, any path segment starting with a dot, answer 404. Unless `follow_symlinks=True`, anything that resolves outside `root`, through a symlink or otherwise, answers 403. A directory is answered with its index file (404 with `index=None`). A directory URL without the trailing slash is redirected to the same URL with it, query string included, and this also works when the app is mounted under a path. Index pages are sent with `Cache-Control: no-cache`; other files get `max-age=<cache_max_age>` when it is set and no Cache-Control otherwise. `root` must be an existing directory: if not, `static()` raises ValueError and the app is left unchanged. Includes tests.

defects.summary: Only the last path segment is checked for a leading dot, so files inside hidden directories such as .git/ are served.
defects.corrected: return any(part.startswith('.') for part in path.split('/'))

defects.summary: The containment check uses abspath, which does not resolve symlinks, so a symlink below root serves files from anywhere on disk.
The trailing-slash redirect is built from request.path, which drops SCRIPT_NAME, so a mounted app redirects out of its mount point.
The response headers are written into the shared options dict, so the no-cache of an index page sticks to every later file response and changes the caller's headers dict.
The routes are registered before root is checked, so a failed call still leaves routes that shadow later ones.
defects.corrected:
if not os.path.isdir(root):
            raise ValueError('Static root is not a directory: %r' % root)
        self.route(prefix + '<path:path>', ['GET', 'HEAD'], serve)
        self.route(prefix, ['GET', 'HEAD'], serve)
defects.defective:
self.route(prefix + '<path:path>', ['GET', 'HEAD'], serve)
        self.route(prefix, ['GET', 'HEAD'], serve)
        if not os.path.isdir(root):
            raise ValueError('Static root is not a directory: %r' % root)

decoys.why: The joined path is only used for the directory test and for _resolves_inside(); a path out of root answers 403 there, and static_file() checks it again.

decoys.anchor: path, target = path + index, os.path.join(target, index)
decoys.why: At this point path is empty or ends with a slash, because a directory path without one was redirected above, so plain concatenation is right.

ceiling.summary: static_file() now compares against root without a trailing separator, so for root /srv/pub a request for ../pub-private/key.txt passes the containment check and files from any sibling directory whose name starts with the root's name are served.
